rag.description: Starts an Android activity by package and activity name through the Appium UiAutomator2 mobile: startActivity command, which brings that screen to the foreground. Android recordings produce this action when the app moves to another activity.

qa.question: What does the SwitchActivity action do?
qa.answer: It starts the Android activity named by Package and Activity through the Appium mobile: startActivity command, so that screen comes to the foreground.

qa.question: Which inputs does SwitchActivity use?
qa.answer: Activity is mandatory; Package is optional. With both, the intent is package/activity. When Activity already contains a slash, it is used as the full intent and Package is ignored.

qa.question: What happens when Activity is missing?
qa.answer: The step fails with an ArgumentException before any driver call, because Android cannot start an empty intent.

qa.question: Which drivers support SwitchActivity?
qa.answer: Android sessions on the Appium UiAutomator2 driver, which implements mobile: startActivity. Other drivers reject the command.

qa.question: Where does SwitchActivity come from in a recorded flow?
qa.answer: The G4 Android recorder records a window change to a new activity as SwitchActivity, and the Hub writes it as {{$ --Package:<package> --Activity:<activity>}}.

qa.question: What is the manifest version of SwitchActivity?

description: ### Purpose
Starts an Android activity by its package and activity name, which brings that screen to the foreground.
The action calls the Appium UiAutomator2 `mobile: startActivity` command with the intent `package/activity`.
Use it to open a screen directly, without navigating to it through the user interface.
The G4 Android recorder records a move to another activity as this action.
### Key Features and Functionality
| Feature                  | Description                                                        |
| Direct Navigation        | Opens an activity by name instead of tapping through the app.      |
| Intent Building          | Joins Package and Activity as package/activity.                    |
| Full Intent Pass-Through | Uses Activity as the full intent when it already contains a slash. |
| Early Validation         | Fails before any driver call when Activity is missing.             |
### Usages in RPA
| Use Case         | Description                                                          |
| Jump to a Screen | Opens a settings or report screen directly to save navigation steps. |
| Recover a Flow   | Returns the app to a known screen after an unexpected dialog.        |
### Usages in Automation Testing
| Use Case             | Description                                                  |
| Screen Isolation     | Starts each test on the activity under test.                 |
| Recorded Flow Replay | Replays a screen change captured by the G4 Android recorder. |

description: ### Open an activity by its full intent
Starts the activity from a full `package/activity` intent, without a separate Package argument.
Activity names the Android activity to start, such as com.example.app.MainActivity.
When it contains a slash it is used as the full package/activity intent and Package is ignored.
It is mandatory; a missing value fails the step before any driver call.
parameters.name: Activity

description: Package names the Android package that owns the activity, such as com.example.app.
It is joined with Activity as package/activity.
It is ignored when Activity already holds a full intent.
